implemented_priorities: Reuse compiler-proven shared operand facts in commitment reduction, extension arithmetic and paired FRI selections, preserving ordinary folding, CSE and instruction order.
Emit dense periodic coefficients into the first extension limb only, removing redundant zero interning and add-zero probes.
Use explicitly charged hash fingerprints and occupancy bytes to avoid unnecessary payload probes and clear retained maps cheaply, preserving full-key equality and stale-token checks.
Prepare graphs on bounded workers; publish phase receipts after scratch and excess compiler backing are dropped. Queue progress wakes the coordinator without retiring the job or polling.
Prefer matching public layouts, leave growth room for nearly full mismatched backing, learn refusal caps within exact geometries, and retry within the same pool while retaining completed jobs.
